en.headline: No. 3 alarm fire breaks out at Mai Po warehouse
en.dek: Firefighters used three jets and breathing apparatus teams after the blaze at Luk Mei Tsuen was upgraded early on Friday; no casualties have been reported.
body: A fire broke out at a warehouse in Luk Mei Tsuen, Mai Po, at about 3.28 am on Friday and was upgraded to a No. 3 alarm at 4.53 am, the Fire Services Department said.

Firemen deployed three jets and mobilised three breathing apparatus teams to fight the blaze. A separate special announcement advised people affected by smoke or an unusual odour carried by the wind to close their doors and windows and stay calm.
No casualties have been reported so far. The department continued firefighting operations through the early morning.

zh.headline: 米埔倉庫三級火 消防出動三條喉及煙帽隊
zh.dek: 元朗米埔綠美村倉庫凌晨起火，約四時半升為三級火，消防以三條喉及煙帽隊灌救，暫未有人受傷。
body: 消防處表示，星期五凌晨約三時二十八分，元朗米埔綠美村一倉庫發生火警，至四時五十三分升為三級火。
消防出動三條喉及三隊煙帽隊灌救。當局另發出特別公告，呼籲受煙霧或異味影響的市民關閉門窗並保持冷靜。
目前未有報告有人受傷。消防繼續在現場進行救火工作。
